generation.prompt: Create one photorealistic editorial product photograph for a Korean Himawari bag journal. Use the reference as the exact product: No.1010 sage khaki rectangular backpack, black twin handles, two black straps and buckles on the front flap pocket, white rectangular Himawari label, black piping and zippers. Preserve all bag geometry, color, logo spelling, pocket arrangement and proportions faithfully. Show the entire CLOSED bag standing on a pale wood bench immediately beside an open pale cream personal locker; the locker is empty, door open to the side. Product prominently occupies about half frame, unobstructed front view with subtle side depth. Calm daylight, natural textile texture, restrained warm cream and sage palette. Landscape 3:2 composition, no people, no extra products, no added text or labels, no invented bag features. This is a styled scene, not a demonstration of exact locker fit.

overlapReview: Reviewed all 44 titles, summaries and full article bodies. Locker article focuses on door clearance and opening geometry, not long-term storage. Glasses article focuses on case fit and pressure, not generic pouch sorting. Shopping article addresses new return-trip purchases and a separate carrier, not reducing existing everyday contents. Three distinct models and photos.
